newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso unchanged in active two-way trades.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso unchanged in active two-way trades.

text.p: * Central Bank was both buyer and seller of dollars
The Philippine peso closed unchanged at 26.269 pesos to the dollar on Wednesday in active two-way trading, traders said.
They said Central Bank was both a buyer and seller of dollars which kept the peso wedged within a narrow band.
The average rate also remained at 26.268 from the previous day, with turnover rising to $127.10 million from $96.50 million.
"Some banks were biddish (on the dollar) due to equities and corporate requirements," said one dealer.
But the Central Bank stopped the peso from weakening by selling dollars at 26.27 pesos.
Inflows also came in, prompting the Central Bank to buy dollars, traders said. One dealer said the Central Bank purchased dollars at 26.266 pesos for same-day delivery of dollars.
Dealers estimate the Central Bank was a net buyer of some $7.0 to 8.0 million.
